channel.title: Nature Communications
channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [7] Distinguishing intrinsic and interfacial pyroelectric effects by polarization reversal measurements
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Chris R. Bowen, Ya Yang

Authors: Huiyu Dan, Weiqi Qian, Chong Guo, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Condensed matter paper on ferroelectric films and pyroelectric effects.

Tags: #ferroelectrics #materialsscience #characterizationmethod

Abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 15 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74459-1 The authors develop a polarization reversal method to distinguish intrinsic and interfacial pyroelectric effects in ferroelectric films and clarify their material-specific dominance. It enables the development of better thermal energy harvesters and sensors.
